Silver denarius of Hadrian Date: 117-138 Diameter 19mm, weight 2.36g Obverse: Laureate bust facing right Obverse inscription: [I]MP [CA]ESA[R TRAIANVS HA]DRIANVS AV[G] Reverse: possible Pax standing. Reverse inscription: P M TR P CO[S] […], in ex PAX Condition: poor, heavy damage to both the obverse and reverse sides
